lamp.title: Selected alcohol lamp
lamp.moveHint: Move a beaker or test tube into the marked zone above this lamp to heat it. Move it away or extinguish the lamp to stop heating.
lamp.waitHint: A filled container is checked for a registered heat reaction after a short illustrative wait. No exact temperature is calculated.
heat.heating: Heating over a lit alcohol lamp.
heat.cancelHint: Move the sample out and back into a lit zone, or change contents, to start another heat check.
result.unsupported: No registered {{trigger}} demonstration matches this sample. This result does not establish what happens in a real laboratory.
result.retry: Empty this container to try a different sample, or use the other supported trigger. Only predefined reactions are available.
result.precipitateLegend: ↓ marks a precipitate: an insoluble solid that forms in the solution.
result.gasLegend: ↑ marks gas released by the reaction.
result.warmingLegend: The thermometer symbol indicates warming; the solution remains clear. It is not a temperature measurement.
result.heatLegend: Heating time and colors are illustrative; no exact temperature is calculated.
result.solidGasLegend: Outlined particles illustrate gas release; carbon dioxide itself is colorless.
effect.gas.solid: Gas is released from the heated solid.
effect.solid.pale-white: The solid becomes much paler or white.
effect.warming: A subtle temperature rise is indicated; no precipitate or gas forms.
dialog.title: Selected sample detail
dialog.starting: Starting sample. No reaction result yet; use Mix or heat the container over a lit lamp to check a supported demonstration.
replay.liveHint: Live reaction visualization. Replay is available when it finishes.
replay.playingHint: Teaching replay — visual explanation only. The live sample is unchanged.
replay.readyHint: Replay the recorded visualization. The live sample stays unchanged.
replay.heatHint: This illustrates the recorded heating reaction; it does not heat the live sample.
replay.autoAnnouncement: Auto replay enabled. Stop replay or turn off Auto replay to finish.
help.title: How to use this lab
help.mixEquipment: Add a beaker or test tube from Equipment, then select it on the bench.
help.mixChemicals: Click chemicals to add them to that container.
help.mixResult: Press Mix, then read the observation and equation. Click the sample close-up to enlarge it.
help.heatChemicals: Add chemicals to a beaker or test tube.
help.heatLamp: Add an alcohol lamp, select it and press Ignite lamp.
help.heatPosition: Move the container center into the marked zone above the lit lamp. Wait for the heat result.
help.heatStop: Move the sample away or extinguish the lamp to stop heating.
help.controls: Click or tap equipment to add/select it; drag on the bench to move. Arrow keys move focused equipment, Shift moves farther and Escape cancels a drag.
help.quantities: Solution means a liquid sample; Solid means a solid sample. Each click adds one simplified unit, not a measured mL or mole.
help.reset: Empty container clears only the selected sample. Reset lab removes all equipment, contents, lamps and results.
help.limits: Only registered Mix and Heat demonstrations are supported. Concentration and exact temperature are not modeled. This virtual lab does not replace real laboratory instructions or safety procedures.
